description: Read wallet operational status: key mode (live/test, derived locally from the sk_ prefix — no API call), whether an API key is configured, whether the seed backup is confirmed, the current guardrail budget (rolling-24h + per-tx caps and usage), and the crash-resume summaries from boot (pending withdrawals + pending conversions). Moves no money.
name: wallet_status

api_key_configured.description: Whether an API key is set (deposit/withdraw need one).

backup_confirmed.description: Whether the seed backup was confirmed — receive is gated until true (§2.9).

allowlist_enabled.description: Whether the owner turned the destination allowlist on (§4.3).

daily_limit_cents.description: Owner-set rolling-24h cap in BRL cents (§4.2).

per_tx_limit_cents.description: Owner-set per-transaction cap in BRL cents (§4.2).

used_cents.description: BRL cents committed in the rolling 24h window.

mode.description: Key mode, derived LOCALLY from the sk_live_/sk_test_ prefix — no API call (§6.2).

pending_conversions.description: Conversion crash-recovery summary from boot (§5): Boltz swaps reconciled, peg-in reconciled, SideShift shifts refreshed.

boltz.description: Boltz swap reconciliation counters, or null when the wallet has no seed (no Boltz rail).

cleared.description: Tracked peg-ins SideSwap reported Done — cleared.

failed.description: Reconciliation attempts that failed (kept for the next resume).

pending.description: In-flight peg-ins still tracked after reconciliation.

plans.description: Multi-hop conversion plans resumed from the last completed leg (PR-C).

advanced.description: Plans that executed at least one leg this pass (from the last completed leg).

checked.description: In-flight multi-hop conversion plans found in the store.

completed.description: Plans that reached a terminal outcome and were removed.

discarded.description: Tampered plan records discarded (GCM auth failure) — never acted upon.

failed.description: Probe/execution failures — plan kept for the next resume.

needs_review.description: Plans parked for manual completion (recovery would have to guess) — see wallet_pending notes.

checked.description: Non-terminal tracked shifts found in the local log.

failed.description: Status refreshes that failed (kept for the next resume).

refreshed.description: Shifts whose status was refreshed from SideShift.

pending_withdrawals.description: Crash-recovery summary from boot (§3.2.9): auto-resumed/re-broadcast/discarded records.

failed.description: Not resumed now — kept for the next resume (no API key, created under another key mode, or a transient failure).

title: Wallet status
